تستحصلون (form X)
# تَسْتَحْصِلُونَ (tastaḥṣilūna) /tas.taħ.sˤi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# تُسْتَحْصَلُونَ (tustaḥṣalūna) /tus.taħ.sˤa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
